method: Independent author directly translated and self-reviewed every owned field against canonical Japanese. No other translator pair or translation bundle was read.
technicalReviewNotes: Brush contact material, sponge abrasive surface and invisible chemical residues kept distinct.
Bucket capacity versus measurement precision, handles versus lifting approval kept distinct.
Wheelbarrow lever explanation is not a payload calculation; force versus lateral stability distinguished.
Cart rolling, sled sliding and roller supports distinguished without inventing transport procedure.
Forklift machine capability versus cargo mass, training category versus light cargo and public-road conditions distinguished.
Winch pulling versus lifting, drum storage versus rope feeding, sling versus fastening rope distinguished.
Shackle body/pin matching and full-system approval separated; turnbuckle adjustment is not force measurement.
The Japanese site nickname ねこ is retained as a quoted label with the wheelbarrow meaning, not translated as an animal.

corrections.reason: Removed inferred procurement qualification from duplicate arrangements; Japanese does not limit 手配 to procurement.
